segments.text: Hello, my name is Imawis. I work in digital marketing, mostly for sports and community
organization. I am applying for a digital marketing role in soccer. I have around 4
years in digital marketing. I have worked with a local sports club, a small online shop
and a charity. I manage social media, newsletters and some paid ads. I love football and I think
the audience is very passionate. It is a good place to build a community and to use marketing
to connect people with the game. To grow the brand online, create good content, run campaigns,
talk to the community and report the results to the club. First month I research the market
and the audience. Second month I launch content and a few campaigns. Third month I look the
result and the improve. I would also choose the main channels. I look at who is already
engaged with us and how we want to reach. Then I focus on the groups that are most available
like parents and the young players. At the sports club I run a campaign to sell tickets
for a youth tournament. I created post and a short email series and added a small paid
budget. We sold most of the tickets. I learnt to start earlier and test different messages.
I start with what the audience likes. Then the planned content in a calendar. I create
it someone approve it and I published it on the right channels. Afterwards I check how
it performed. I keep the main idea but changes the tone of the benefits. For parents it is
safety and progress. For clubs and parents it is result and visibility. It depends on
the goal and the budget. Organic is good for community, paid for first reach, emails for
people who already know us. I try a mix and see what works. Reach and impressions for
awareness, like and comment for engagements, sign in sign up for leads and repeat visit
for rotations. Conversion is how many people complete the action. I check the number to
see where people opt off. Then I change the simplest things first like the message or
the image and test again.
